Cash Hongbao (Traditional & Safe)** - **Amount:** Follow local customs (e.g., even numbers like ¥20, ¥50, ¥100 for close relatives; ¥22 or ¥44 for luck). Look for **gold/red foil** for extra festivity. - **DIY:** Use red paper (available at craft stores) + glue/stickers. Add a **gold seal (印章)** or calligraphy for a personal touch. - **Alternative:** Use **red envelopes with QR codes** (e.g., WeChat Pay/Alipay) for digital hongbao (if your cousins are tech-savvy). **B. Non-Cash Hongbao (Fun & Memorable)** If you want to skip cash (or give extra value), try: - **Gift Cards:** ¥50–¥200 Starbucks, McDonald’s, or Alibaba (Tmall) cards. Kids love these! - **Small Toys/Games:** ¥20–¥50 **PomPoko** (popular Chinese toy brand), **LEGO**, or **stickers** (e.g., Disney, Hello Kitty). - **Food Coupons:** Vouchers for their favorite snacks (e.g., "¥30 for a box of Mooncakes" or "¥50 for a meal at [local restaurant]"). - **Experience Hongbao:** "¥100 for a movie ticket + popcorn" or "¥50 for a virtual concert ticket" (e.g., Bilibili or Tencent Music). - **Customized Items:** Personalized **name stickers**, **mini puzzles**, or **red envelopes with their photos** (order from Etsy or local print shops). **C.
